amendments.scope: agents/chemist.py: LLM rationale budgeting (AGENTBIO_MAX_LLM_RATIONALES, default top-25 per target pool; non-eligible candidates get the deterministic templated rationale)
amendments.reason: Per-candidate LLM rationale prose was the dominant run cost (Study B: 54,105 rationale calls across 21 targets) while feeding no score, rank, cap, or reviewer verdict — it is disclosure-only prose passed through to the writer.
amendments.impact: None on scored outputs: composite scores, ranks, reviewer verdicts, and evidence profiles are deterministic and unchanged. Checkpoint records written before vs after this amendment differ only in the prose rationale field of non-top candidates (LLM prose vs template). RULE_FINGERPRINT (evidence_profile disposition rule) and cases_sha256 are unchanged; frozen_at_commit intentionally left at the freeze commit — the prod commit-pin check fails open by design (no git in the deployment snapshot).

amendments.scope: validation/run_triage_discrimination_studyc.py: _load_checkpoint now streams line-by-line (was read_text().splitlines(), ~3x transient RAM) and sheds target records for pool-finalized diseases, which assembly never re-reads
amendments.reason: The checkpoint grows past 1GB over the run; the old loader's peak RAM footprint is the suspected cause of the 2026-08-17 prod VM restart that wiped an unfinalized pool and ~4.5h of work.
amendments.impact: None on scored outputs: identical records are validated (rule_fingerprint + cases_sha256 per record, fail-closed) and identical pools reach scoring; only resume-time memory profile changes. Infrastructure, not rules — RULE_FINGERPRINT unchanged.

amendments.scope: validation/run_triage_discrimination_studyc.py: _build_pool converts DiseaseNotInUniverse into DiseaseUnscorable, so out-of-universe cases are recorded as permanent disclosed exclusions instead of stranding in `skipped`
amendments.reason: Case 'Urinary Incontinence' is outside the rare-disease/NTD target universe; the old path returned None on every resume, and results are never written while `skipped` is non-empty — a terminal wedge once it was the last disease standing.
amendments.impact: Completion semantics only: the disease is disclosed under diseases_excluded (same disclosure path as unscorable cases). No scored row, pool, rule_fingerprint, or metric changes.
